notes:
GOAT Sim Coach 0.9.195 (beta) - after the Tsukuba session

SMART
- The lap clock: the reference lap and every spoken delta were a second off on iRacing (the sim keeps counting the previous lap for a moment after the line). Lap times, references and "x tenths up/down" are right now; the sector split is only named when it adds up.
- One reference announcement, not two. "A second", not "1 seconds". The same car closing behind is called again after two minutes, not 30 seconds.
- On the grid before the green, SMART knows the session has not started (no more "get the car back to the pits").
- Whisper knows the radio words: mute, unmute, brake bias, pit stop, fuel to add, fast repair, box this lap.
- SMART knows the Highlights state, so it can explain what is waiting for which replay.

Radar (iRacing)
- A car the spotter says is beside you is drawn beside you, on the side the spotter names - other cars' positions arrive late over the network and used to land the blip on the wrong side.

Highlights
- "Process my highlights" no longer sits greyed for minutes at full CPU before it starts; the progress bar shows a preparing state right away.
- Clips waiting for TV angles are counted per sim: an iRacing replay films iRacing clips, AC clips wait for an AC replay with GOAT Cam.

Corners
- A SPEED light: your minimum speed through the corner against your reference, in the Corners window, the overlay dots, the dashboard and the web corner tree. APEX means position only (grey where the sim gives none).
- The hairpin arrow sits centred like the other arrow shapes.

Telemetry
- GOAT opens your newest session when you come back to it, and again when the sim closes and the new file appears.
- Top three opportunities in the session header. Throttle pickup distances no longer wrap into a whole lap.
- A live-built reference without positions is rebuilt from the session file that holds that lap, so the Corner Debrief compares your line on iRacing sessions too.
- The map in follow mode moves only when the car nears the edge and no longer re-plans imagery on every cursor move. The key-point legend explains the line colours; the braking point is magenta.

Tyres
- The Tyre Overlay and the dashboard label iRacing's bands OUTER / MID / INNER per side, as on Assetto Corsa.

Overlay
- PRACTICE menu (ghost car, drill HUD, skill stint) and a two-column gear menu with DISPLAY (solid background, overlay sets).

Radar
- The radar debug log now records which side each car was drawn on, so a wrong side can be shown call by call.

Recording
- OBS display capture uses Windows Graphics Capture: the fallback layer recorded black on some PCs with the automatic method, and the capture preview with it.
- SMART is told tyre wear per corner (LF, RF, LR, RR), so it names the right tyre.
